newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht firms, interbank rate rises late.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht firms, interbank rate rises late.

text.p: The baht was higher against the dollar in late trade on Wednesday as tightening domestic liquidity prompted dollar selling for baht, dealers said.
The baht was quoted at 26.110/26.115 to the dollar late against 26.120/26.125 in early morning, dealers said.
"The liquidity was tighter today so some players began to unwind their dollar position for baht," said one dealer at a U.S. bank.
The greenback's slight weakness abroad also helped support the baht, dealers said.
The Bank of Thailand fixed the mid-rate at 26.10 per dollar against 26.11 on Tuesday.
The overnight interbank rate rose to 7.50-8.00 percent late verus 6.50-7.00 earlier on tighter money supply, dealers said.
"The interbank rate is expected to firm further on Friday. Some banks began to offer funds at the rate of 8.75-9.00 percent," said one money market dealer.
The market is closed on Thursday for Labour Day.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was traded higher to 5.00/6.00 satangs late from 4.50/5.00 in early morning trade.
